law_name: Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 on Personal Data Protection
scope: Processing of personal data by the State, local authorities and any natural or legal person; persons established, resident or in transit in Cameroon; controllers or processors established in Cameroon
applies_to: State, decentralised local authorities and any other natural or legal person acting as controller or processor established in Cameroon
key_requirements: Data subject consent (art. 21); controller must keep data accurate and up to date (art. 21); transfers abroad only to countries with adequate protection, with approval and safeguards (art. 32)
data_categories: Personal data; sensitive data: religious, philosophical, political and trade-union opinions or activities, racial, ethnic, linguistic or regional origin, genetic and biometric data in health matters (processing prohibited)
enforcement_authority: Autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel (APDP) - independent public body (art. 53)
penalties_range: Companies: fines up to XAF 1 billion; processing despite data-subject objection: 1 to 3 years imprisonment and XAF 50,000 to 1,000,000 fine, or either
genetic_data: Processing of genetic and biometric data in health matters is prohibited (reported summary; article number not given)
notes: 18-month transition ended 23 June 2026; authority creation reported but operational status unclear; Law 2010/012 (cybersecurity and cybercrime) still relevant; draft DPO requirement dropped
